main.file: Pricing- when to raise it- main v4 c4e5a7.mp4
main.srt:
1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:03,300
 Hi, I'm Sallie, and today we're talking about when to

2
00:00:03,300 --> 00:00:05,100
 raise your prices.

3
00:00:05,500 --> 00:00:08,500
 Someone asked me last week if it was too early,

4
00:00:08,500 --> 00:00:11,500
 and my answer was, you do not need a reason.

5
00:00:11,500 --> 00:00:15,100
 You need a pattern. If three people in a row say yes

6
00:00:15,100 --> 00:00:18,500
 without a single question, your price is too low.

7
00:00:18,500 --> 00:00:22,000
 That is the signal. Not your birthday, not inflation.

8
00:00:22,500 --> 00:00:26,300
 When you raise a price, tell people early and plainly.

9
00:00:26,300 --> 00:00:29,300
 Say what is changing, say when it starts,

10
00:00:29,300 --> 00:00:32,200
 and thank the people who have been with you.

11
00:00:32,500 --> 00:00:35,800
 Keep the old price for anyone who is mid-project,

12
00:00:35,800 --> 00:00:38,800
 so nobody feels caught out. Then move on.

13
00:00:39,300 --> 00:00:42,900
 People ask me what percent is fair. Here is my answer.

14
00:00:42,900 --> 00:00:45,900
 Raise it until you hear a little hesitation,

15
00:00:45,900 --> 00:00:49,400
 then stay right there for a month. If the hesitation

16
00:00:49,400 --> 00:00:52,800
 goes away, you can go higher. If it gets louder,

17
00:00:52,800 --> 00:00:55,800
 come back down a little and keep going from there.

18
00:00:56,300 --> 00:00:59,100
 That's it for today. Thanks for watching,

19
00:00:59,100 --> 00:01:01,500
 and I'll see you in the next one.

suggestions.why: Two short stretches that read as one: how to announce a price change, and who keeps the old price.
suggestions.point: Raise a price early and plainly, and keep the old one for work already started.

suggestions.why: One question, one answer, and a rule that can be tried this week.
suggestions.point: Raise a price until people hesitate, hold it for a month, then go higher or come back down a little.

reels.title: Do not wait for everyone else
reels.file: Pricing- when to raise it- reel 2 v1 c4e5a7.mp4
reels.srt:
1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:03,400
 Some people tell me prices are going up everywhere,

2
00:00:03,400 --> 00:00:06,600
 so they wait. That's a trap. Waiting for everyone

3
00:00:06,600 --> 00:00:10,200
 else to move first means you are always the last

4
00:00:10,200 --> 00:00:12,800
 one to be paid properly.
